messages:
sam.marketing: Quick sync  want a tight PLG launch + webinar experiment. Hypothesis: small credit + micro prompt pack + clearer benchmark snippet in posts => lift first-run rate. Aim: +7% first_prompt within 48h. Run 7 days. Thoughts?

hana.growth: +1. Recommend 3 arms: control, $12 credits only, and $12 + 3 micro-templates + guided in-app CTA. Randomize at registration. N per arm ~700.

lina.content: Draft post directions:
- Copy A: 'Claim $12 + starter prompts to ship an LLM feature in minutes'
- Copy B: 'Micro-benchmark: similar latency, ~20% token savings — try with $12'
I'll produce 2 hero gifs (6s) and 1 short landing blurb.

ryan.ops: routing plan: mark webinar signups with trait:plg_trial = true and send to a grant queue. Pseudocode:
```
if (signup.source == 'webinar' && signup.campaign == 'ignite-mini') {
  analytics.identify(userId, { plg_trial: true });
  grants.enqueue({ user: userId, amount: 12, experiment: 'ignite_mini_2025' });
}
```
We should make grants idempotent. Also add a soft daily token cap of 45k for cohort.

ada.rs: eval plan: small prompt set (meeting->tasks, polish email, summarize spec). We'll capture tokens, latency, and a binary quality pass (manual review on a random 10% sample). Export per-user metrics for analysis.

hana.growth: nudge cadence for arm 3: immediate in-app toast with 1-click run; email Day 2 with 3 example templates; Day 5 office hours invite. Keep messages <3 lines.

lina.content: landing flow update: include a short benchmark stat under the CTA: 'Median tokens per task: ~120' (placeholder until eval warms). Helps set expectations.

sam.marketing: timeline: mockups by Thu, routing + grants by Mon, go-live Wed. Owners: creative=lina, routing=ryan, measurement=hana, eval=ada. I'll schedule a quick pre-launch check 1h before.

experiment-bot: Reminder created: 'ignite-mini go/no-go check' on 2025-09-09 13:00 UTC.

ryan.ops: infra notes: webhook rate-limit 6/s, grant queue dedupe key = user.id, alert at 60% of token cap. Adding runbook entries for manual revoke.

ada.rs: when harness starts, I'll share median token numbers and a small quality sample by EOD tomorrow.

hana.growth: measurement: primary = first_prompt within 48h, secondary = 7d_active and median tokens. Use Amplitude + SQL cohort export. I'll set experiment flags and track by experiment_id.

lina.content: uploading two hero gif drafts to #marketing-drafts now. One shows 'claim -> run -> result', other shows 'benchmark callout -> claim'.

sam.marketing: perfect. final checklist: gifs in drafts, grants infra deployed, experiment flag live, amplitude events instrumented, eval harness running. Ping here when ready and I'll trigger the deploy. :rocket:
